schema.description: Request schema for creating a booking intent via a public interface.

auto_assign_provider.description: When true, automatically assigns an available provider for the selected time slot if no provider_id is specified.

anyOf.description: Progressive client data for a booking intent. All fields are optional; provided fields are merged with existing values.

fields.description: A map of custom field values to set on the client, keyed by field slug. Each key must correspond to a Client Field that has been defined in the account; arbitrary key-value pairs are not accepted.

locale.description: The locale of the client booking the appointment.

reference_id.description: External reference identifier for the client.

anyOf.title: ClientDataInput

client_data.description: Progressive client data to collect during the booking flow.

end_at.description: The end time of the slot as an ISO-8601 datetime string with a timezone offset.

provider_id.description: The ID of the provider to assign.

service_id.description: The ID of the service for this booking intent.

start_at.description: The start time of the slot as an ISO-8601 datetime string with a timezone offset.

submissions.description: Form submissions to attach to this booking intent. Each entry contains a form_id and responses map.

items.description: A form submission entry containing a form ID and response data.

form_id.description: The ID of the form to submit responses for.

responses.description: A map of response data keyed by field key. Values depend on field type.

items.title: IntentSubmissionInput

time_zone.description: The local time zone for the slot (IANA format).

schema.title: CreatePublicBookingIntentRequest
